Arcline Logistics appoints Marta Alvés as Chief Operating Officer

Arcline Logistics appointed Marta Alvés as Chief Operating Officer, effective November 3, succeeding founder-led operations.

All releasesPublish your own

CHICAGO, IL, UNITED STATES — October 17, 2026

Arcline Logistics today announced the appointment of Marta Alvés as Chief Operating Officer, effective November 3. Alvés joins from a European freight group where she led network operations across 14 countries.

The appointment follows a two-year period in which Arcline grew from 11 to 29 distribution centres. The company said Alvés will own network design, labour planning and the consolidation programme announced in June.

Founder Gregory Lindqvist continues as Chief Executive, moving out of day-to-day operations.

“We have built a network faster than we built the systems to run it. That is a solvable problem and it is the one I have been hired to solve.”

— Marta Alvés, Chief Operating Officer, Arcline Logistics

About Arcline Logistics

Arcline Logistics operates 29 distribution centres across North America and Europe, serving industrial and consumer goods shippers.
